text: German is the main language of Germany, Austria and Liechtenstein, and one of the four national languages of Switzerland. Together they are often called D-A-CH (D for Deutschland, A for Austria, CH for Confoederatio Helvetica). Germany has 16 federal states (Bundesländer), Austria has 9, and Switzerland has 26 cantons.
The capitals are Berlin, Vienna (Wien) and Bern. Each country has its own culture, history and way of speaking German.
